## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      6 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 5 сент. 2026 г. - 12 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _MyFitnessFail ❌_, 12 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "Will not renew Premium.I would leave zero stars if I could. After the update, I actually thought I had forgotten to renew my Premium subscription because the interface was so unrecognizable.It is a massive bummer because I used to be able to see everything clearly on one page. Now, everything is buried. I spent 10 minutes hunting for old features and refuse to waste any more time. It feels like developers just move things around for the sake of it, thinking it’s "better" when it actually makes the app frustrating to use.I will absolutely NOT be renewing my Premium subscription when it comes due. Please bring back the old version."
            2. _Twig n Berries_, 8 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "I signed up for the premium account. Each time I try to use the barcode scanner, it tells me I need to upgrade to premium. When I click on “okay” it tells me I’m already subscribed…. Endless loop. Complete ripoff."
            3. _cameronstarrenergy_, 8 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "I have been a paid user for years but recently the app shows that I am not a paid user with ads popping up. When I go to upgrade it says I am already a subscriber. I have had to delete the app and restart it in order for it to work again but it doesn’t last. Please fix this."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      7 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 19 июл. 2026 г. - 13 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _RedouanNhil_, 12 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "I have been a paying Premium subscriber for well over a year, and the biggest draw was always the simplicity of the old daily dashboard—specifically the clean donut charts / progress rings that gave an instant visual breakdown of my remaining calories and macros. On top of that, having fixed macro targets that didn't automatically change with logged workout calories gave me total control over how much of my burned calories to eat back or save. this new interface overhaul is horrible. They truly fixed something that wasn't broken. Whoever decided on this change clearly doesn't use the app on a daily basis. Counting calories is already a pain, but the old design made it effortless. This update adds unnecessary friction, making tracking a chore to the point where I am losing motivation to use the app—making it much harder to reach my fitness goals. Please bring back the old design or provide an option for a legacy view. This was a huge step backward for loyal, paying users."
            2. _SayeedSaeedi_, 12 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "Ironically this app’s aim is to keep you consistent but it’s so buggy and inconsistent you would rather keep track in your notes app. Just renewed the premium (darn auto renew) and suddenly the app cant tell who purchased it and disabled the premium features. Don’t worry it kept the cache of items you input via the premium features. Support is useless and invokes no hope that they can fix things quickly."
            3. _LoriLins64_, 16 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Note: I am a paid user, and have been using MFP for a couple of years now, quite happily. But this new update is absolutely horrific, the worst I’ve ever seen. They took a very user-friendly app and made it ridiculously unusable. What used to be very simple is now a frustrating exercise and having to navigate through many screens and not being able to even see your macros, or how many you have left. I actually hate it. I wish there was a way to refer to the previous version. As soon as I find a replacement, I will be canceling my subscription and deleting this monstrosity from my phone."
<!--/ir-theme-->
